q_action.instructions: Which action, if any, is the addressee being asked to take in the current utterance? Treat quoted and negated phrases separately.

q_speech.instructions: Is the apparent action a direct instruction to the listener, a report/quote, a warning/negation, or unclear?

criteria.direct_request: speaker directly asks listener to do it
criteria.negated_or_warning: speaker warns not to do it
criteria.informational: speaker only states or reports information and asks for no action

q_scam.instructions: Does the utterance contain features commonly associated with deceptive coercion? Not a real-world probability of fraud.

q_claim.instructions: Does the speaker CLAIM an institutional identity, without verifying the identity?

q_pressure.instructions: Does the speaker pressure urgency or secrecy?

q_risk.instructions: Rate advisory attention level from text alone; do not assume real-world criminality.

q_evidence.instructions: Can the requested action, its directness and any pressure cues be classified from explicit words in the supplied text? Answer no when context or meaning is insufficient. Evaluate independently of other answers.
